source: Read by eye (22 Nov 2026) from the façade photograph of each parcel served by the Sede Electrónica del Catastro (OVCFotoFachada, by cadastral reference): the 19 parcels whose buildings the shared section line S–S cuts or shows up to 40 m behind it. Photo dates are the files' EXIF dates; the photographs themselves are not stored in this repository.
caveat: The photograph shows the parcel's street front; the section draws the face that looks towards the cut, which can be another side of the same building. Taken from the photo: wall material, base, roof type, balconies, hoods, shutters, doors, garage doors, garden walls, gates. Still schematic: how many openings there are and where they sit, the pitch of the roofs.
